mechanism.claim: When at least four of six liquid alt perpetuals settle funding materially above or below BTC funding and each relative spread is extreme versus its own causal history, leverage crowding is cross-sectionally concentrated outside BTC. During elevated BTC variation, fade the common relative-funding sign in BTC over the next funding cycle as crowded crypto inventory unwinds.
mechanism.side: negative strict common sign of at least four extreme alt-minus-BTC funding spreads
mechanism.why_distinct: HVEFR fades BTC funding relative to its own median. HVCAPCR fades continuous alt premium-index levels. Cross-venue funding fracture compares venues. HVCAFRU instead uses six simultaneous realized alt-minus-BTC funding settlement spreads, each normalized only by its own strict-prior distribution, and requires a cross-sectional tail breadth; it uses no price direction, premium, OI, flow, turnover, fitted outcome, prior event set, or promoted control.
mechanism.why_suited_to_volatile_regimes: completed prior-24h BTC realized variation must rank in its causal upper 35 percent, selecting July-like volatile states
mechanism.why_low_gross9_overlap_is_plausible: irregular cross-alt relative-funding tail onsets at settlement boundaries are absent from Gross9 primitives

features.decision_grid: actual UTC funding_time values at which BTCUSDT and all six alts have one exact settlement record
features.funding_spread: alt funding_rate minus simultaneous BTCUSDT funding_rate, finite strict nonzero
features.spread_history: per alt at most 270 strictly prior source-valid common settlements, minimum 180, current excluded
features.spread_extremity_rank: strict-prior midrank of absolute funding_spread in that alt history
features.consensus: at least four tail alts have one common strict funding_spread sign; larger breadth wins and equal positive/negative breadth rejects
features.consensus_strength: median spread_extremity_rank among selected-side tail alts
features.btc_realized_variation: sqrt(sum squared exact BTCUSDT one-minute log(close/open) returns over [funding_time-24h,funding_time)), finite strict positive
features.variation_rank: strict-prior midrank over at most 270 earlier source-valid common settlements, minimum 180, current excluded; rank>=0.65
features.eligible_state: source-valid funding consensus plus variation gate
features.onset: eligible now and immediately previous source-valid common settlement ineligible; missing prior cannot trigger
features.causal_availability: funding rates are used only at their actual completed settlement timestamp; BTC path ends strictly before decision

clock.decision: actual common funding settlement after all seven rates and prior BTC path complete
clock.reservation: global chronological half-open; exit first on equal entry
clock.funding: signal settlement is pre-entry; all held-interval exact funding included only after novelty

economic_gates.accounting: fixed quantity, exact funding, 6bp/10bp per notional side, every held 5m favorable then adverse, global HWM, full-calendar CAGR

source_plan.execution_prices: sealed until source and Gross9 novelty pass

stopping_rule: terminal first failure; no universe, spread, history, rank, breadth, variation, onset, side, clock, hold, subset, threshold, source, comparator, or control repair
